thread:
Noah: AP noticed a ~3.7% drop in net vendor charges on today's invoice vs expected. Found an extra `volume_tiers` column in vendor_price_v3.csv that wasn't in the spec. This likely impacts the A/B experiment pricing for cohort B.
Priya: Which vendor? When did the file change?
Noah: Vendor: CloudFerry (CF-43). File updated at 2026-04-05 02:41 UTC. Diff:
```
-old: plan,unit_price
-new: plan,unit_price,volume_tiers
```
Example: volume_tiers = "0-100k:0.00;100k-1M:0.04;>1M:0.08"
Maya: If ingestion maps that to our price engine, cohort B could pick up vendor volume discounts in addition to our experiment split. That's not intended.
James: We shipped mapping for cohort assignments last week. Can we gate the ingestion pipeline?
Tom: Eng-billing: can lock the vendor price sync and force last-good file back. ETA?
Ava: Yes. I can roll back the ingest within 15m and run a schema validation to reject new columns until we sign off.
BillingBot: Price sync paused for CF-43. roll_id=roll-20260405-17. Validation: pending manual accept.
Eleanor: Procurement 1: did we get a formal change notice from CloudFerry? Procurement says no signed amendment.
Priya: Procurement will reach out to vendor immediately asking for change rationale and effective date.
Noah: We need to know if this was retroactive (affects prior usage windows) or forward-looking. That determines credits/grandfathering.
James: For the experiment, I propose: 1) Pause cohort B routing onto new pricing 2) Recompute dry-run invoices for the experiment window 3) If retroactive, offer targeted credits and grandfather active customers for 30 days 4) If forward-only, reconcile and resume with updated communication.
Maya: Agree. Also need CFO or finance lead sign-off for any credits > $5k. @Eleanor please flag.
Eleanor: Noted. I'll prepare an approval request and early estimate. Legal: vendor T&C might allow variable billing but we need a paper trail.
Tom: Ops checklist I'll run: a) rollback ingest, b) lock schema, c) mark affected cohorts, d) run sim. I'll update ops doc: https://redwood.internal/ops/finance/vendor-schema-events
Ava: Simulation queued: sim_cf43_20260405, ETA 30m. Will post deltas per cohort.
BillingBot: Simulation started: sim_id=sim-cf43-0405-1. Output will land in /sims/cf43/0405/results.csv
Priya: I've opened a vendor escalation ticket and requested a written confirmation of the change time and whether they intended retroactive application.
Noah: Support 1: Ella, please draft a brief language for affected customers if credits are needed. Keep it neutral and explain we're investigating.
Ella: Draft ready. Will share in #announcements-drafts for legal review.
James: If crediting, propose automation rules: credit only the delta attributable to vendor-tier overlap, do not double-credit our experiment discount. Keep audit trail per account.
Eleanor: Also run revenue-recognition impact calc. If retroactive adjustments cross reporting cutoff, we need to inform accounting.
Maya: Decision path: vendor revert within 24h -> resume AB after validation; vendor insists -> require procurement/legal renegotiation and temporary cohort hold + credit plan. Can we commit to that?
Tom: Yes. I'll tag owners on the ops doc and assign follow-ups.
Ava: Simulation results: cohort B expected invoice delta = -3.6% (vendor discount reduced net vendor charges), but net customer charges would be -1.2% if we pass-through. Detailed CSV uploaded.
BillingBot: Simulation complete: sim_id=sim-cf43-0405-1, file=/sims/cf43/0405/results.csv
Priya: Vendor replied: change pushed accidentally by CF automation, effective 2026-04-05 02:41 UTC, they will revert within 6 hours. They've apologized and asked us to confirm if we need a written amendment.
James: Good. Let's accept revert. Plan: accept revert, run final sim post-revert, resume A/B only after final sim confirms no regressions.
Eleanor: Approved provisional credit policy if vendor doesn't revert: up to $10k per vendor-event without CFO signoff; above that require CFO approval.
Maya: Noted. Keep this thread as canonical. Final check-in once revert done.
Noah: Revert confirmed at 2026-04-05 04:20 UTC. Eng-billing re-ingested prior-good file.
BillingBot: Re-ingest complete. Validation passed. Final sim queued: sim_id=sim-cf43-0405-2.
Ava: Final sim shows no material impact after revert. Cohort B deltas within noise (<0.2%). Recommend resuming A/B in 30m after monitoring.
James: Resume scheduled at 2026-04-05 05:00 UTC. I'll post a short customer update in #announcements once monitoring window is clean.
Maya: Thanks team. Documented in finance audit and ops doc.
